pages.quiz:
CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the costume
   B. The ticket price
   C. The speed of the music
   D. Only the volume

2. Best practice when working on Drawing and Painting: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Drawing and Painting.
   B. Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Drawing and Painting.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Drawing and Painting.

3. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Swimming.
   B. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.

4. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace drinking water
   B. Remove the need for rules
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Guarantee a trophy

5. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   B. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   D. Damage equipment used for Melody.

6. Best practice when working on Components of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Damage equipment used for Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Components of Creative Arts and Sports.

7. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   D. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Games Board games: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Games Board games.
   B. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games Board games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Games Board games.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Games Board games.

9. Best practice when working on Careers in Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Careers in Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Careers in Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Damage equipment used for Careers in Creative Arts and Sports.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Careers in Creative Arts and Sports.

10. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Red, blue, and yellow
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Green, orange, and purple

11. Best practice when working on Rugby: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Rugby.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Rugby.
   C. Damage equipment used for Rugby.
   D. Practise Rugby with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. Best practice when working on Swimming 10 2.12.2 Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts : (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Swimming 10 2.12.2 Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   B. Disrupt classmates during Swimming 10 2.12.2 Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   C. Damage equipment used for Swimming 10 2.12.2 Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   D. Practise Swimming 10 2.12.2 Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts  with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Anal and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Athletics and Mosaic and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Melody and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

2. B — Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. C — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

8. B — Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games Board games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. A — Practise Careers in Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. A — Red, blue, and yellow

11. D — Practise Rugby with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. D — Practise Swimming 10 2.12.2 Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts  with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

16. (4 marks)
